function.description: Append one record (or a list of records) to a JSON-lines file: each object becomes ONE compact line. Use this for targets.jsonl / contact-log.jsonl — never write_file or a pretty-printed object.
function.name: filesystem_jsonl_append

parameters.description:
056 WS2: append one record (or a list of records) to a JSON-lines file —
ONE compact line per object, the shape Rob's stores (`targets.jsonl`,
`contact-log.jsonl`) require.

record.description: A JSON object, or a list of JSON objects. Each becomes one compact line.
